analogy.rationale: Imidazoline receptors are poorly expressed in these cell lines, so antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other imidazoline ligands and, more weakly, adrenergic/G-protein-coupled receptor antagonists that share some imidazoline-binding pharmacology.
